items.title: Preview web apps live as your coding agent builds them with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore runtime
items.summary: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Session endpoints give each runtime session an authenticated URL that forwards any HTTP method, path, and WebSocket connection to the ports you allow. In this post, you deploy a coding agent that keeps a Vite website running in its session, then watch the live site update in your browser as the agent edits files.
items.creator: Sundar Raghavan
